name: Standing Defense Strategy
description: Alex Enriquez's Wrestling Takedown Defense For Grappling covers stance, sprawls, leg attacks and clearing wrestling ties.
summary: Wrestling Takedown Defense For Grappling by Alex Enriquez covers defending shots from space, established leg grips and upper-body ties.
overview: Alex Enriquez brings stance and sprawl fundamentals together with defenses to specific wrestling attacks. The course addresses singles and doubles from space as well as situations where the opponent already holds an elevated leg. Ankle picks, fireman's carry and dogfight positions are also included, followed by material on head and hip position, overhooks and clearing underhooks. This is a focused option for grapplers whose problems begin on the feet.

products.title: Wrestling Takedown Defense For Grappling
products.blurb: Wrestling defense from the initial shot through established leg grips and upper-body ties.
products.best_for: Grapplers developing takedown defense and responses to wrestling control ties.

fits: You struggle with wrestling shots or with recovering once an opponent has secured your leg.
You want takedown defense that also addresses upper-body ties and their removal.

includes: Stance, motion, sprawl and defensive principles, with stance-and-motion and head-blocking drills.
Single- and double-leg defense, elevated-leg situations, ankle picks, low singles, fireman's carry and dogfight cases.
Head and hip positioning, whizzer/overhook use, front-headlock throw defense and clearing single or double underhooks.
limits: The curriculum is wrestling defense for grappling. Gi-specific collar-and-sleeve fighting and competition guard-pull strategy are outside its advertised scope.
